name: Shaoshuai Mou
title: Elmer Bruhn Professor of Aeronautics and Astronautics; Co-Director, ICON
department: School of Aeronautics and Astronautics; Electrical and Computer Engineering by courtesy
fitReason: Direct overlap with data-efficient robot reinforcement learning, learned dynamics, and control rather than only abstract network optimization.

physicalEvidence.summary: April 21, 2026 PGDK-Online paper reports real Kinova arm goal tracking/obstacle avoidance and Unitree Go1 goal-pose tracking. The arm policy is trained in Gazebo before physical deployment; Go1 uses motion capture. First author Wenjian Hao identifies Mou as his current Purdue PhD adviser. Hardware claims are task-specific, not a general autonomous-locomotion or safety guarantee.
